description: THE TWO ACTIONS THAT NAME DEAD POWERS WERE, UNTIL THIS FLOW EXISTED, DEAD POWERS THEMSELVES: no command, no window, no other flow ever called `unused_actions` or `dormant_steps` — found while verifying them. This flow is the ordinary gesture that reaches them. It runs both, hands the two reports to a person, and starts nothing on its own — the same shape as `notice-a-divergence`: propose, never execute. `unused_actions` answers from the flow files alone (never named by any shipped or project flow); `dormant_steps` answers from the ledger (named, but every closed run of that step was `Skipped`, or the flow itself has never run at all — three different states, never collapsed into one number).

$join:
Two reports on Sailor's own dead powers.

NEVER NAMED BY ANY FLOW (static, from the flow files):
NAMED, BUT NEVER REALLY REACHED (from the ledger — never run at all, always skipped by its own condition, or reached at least once):
Neither list is a verdict on its own: a name here may be a recent flow nobody has had occasion to run yet, not a mistake. Read before acting.

options.label: acknowledged
options.facts: read; nothing in either list needs a change right now

options.label: acted
options.facts: at least one name in either list led to a fault, a flow change, or a fix
